channel.title: Day1 Startup Media
channel.description: Day1 Startup Media covers new Indian startups: launch news, founder stories and the businesses building from day one.

item.title: OrbitQR wants to turn happy customers into Google reviews with one QR scan
item.description: OrbitQR uses a simple QR code and AI-written review suggestions in Indian languages to help businesses collect more Google reviews and reply to them automatically.

item.title: AgriBills is building billing software made for the grain trade
item.description: AgriBills automates paddy and rice billing, including suit cutting calculations, deductions and lot tracking, and is expanding to all agri-based grains.

item.title: Scrappo brings doorstep scrap pickup and disposal to Mumbai
item.description: Mumbai startup Scrappo picks up scrap from your doorstep, from newspapers and metal to e-waste and old furniture, and takes care of proper disposal.

item.title: Mangwale is building a zero-commission delivery platform for local businesses
item.description: Mangwale is working on a zero-commission platform that connects restaurants, local stores and parcel delivery with digital customers.

item.title: LifeMate wants to handle your everyday errands so you can get your time back
item.description: LifeMate, focused on Malad West in Mumbai, sends an executive to handle everyday tasks like pickups, errands, queues, shopping and senior assistance.

item.title: Flipkart is coming for food delivery with 'Eat-In by Minutes'
item.description: Flipkart is testing Eat-In by Minutes, a food delivery service, with employees in Bengaluru, and is reportedly offering restaurants a much lower commission.

item.title: Tech30 2026: the 30 deep-tech startups to watch, from drones to chips
item.description: YourStory's Tech30 2026 list picks 30 Indian startups building core technology: drones, chips, space, robotics, health and clean energy.

item.title: OpenAI buys Orchestra Bio, Ashoka Rajendra's drug-development startup
item.description: OpenAI has acquired Orchestra Bio, the startup Ashoka Rajendra built to help pharma teams run drug development. Rajendra joins OpenAI's Life Sciences team.

item.title: Deepinder Goyal is building Dark.ai, an AI assistant that can't read your chats
item.description: Eternal founder Deepinder Goyal is developing Dark.ai, a privacy-first AI assistant with end-to-end encryption, aiming for a global launch by the end of 2026.

item.title: OYO's parent PRISM nearly halves its IPO fresh issue to ₹3,350 crore
item.description: PRISM, OYO's parent, plans to cut the fresh issue in its IPO to ₹3,350 crore from about ₹6,650 crore as stronger cash generation lowers its funding needs.

item.title: Flipkart backs travel-tech startup TravClan in a $5 million round
item.description: TravClan, which powers more than 15,000 travel agents, has raised $5 million from Flipkart and August One, plus debt from Trifecta Capital.

item.title: Ex-PharmEasy founders' Chapter Home raises ₹63 crore at a near ₹1,000 crore valuation
item.description: Home and kitchen brand builder Chapter Home has raised ₹63 crore in equity and debt from Bessemer, Stride Ventures, Tanmay Bhat and family offices.

item.title: CureBay raises ₹100 crore to take its rural clinics to more states
item.description: Rural healthcare startup CureBay has raised ₹100 crore in a Pre-Series C round led by IvyCap Ventures, to expand its tech-enabled clinic network.

item.title: Hunar.AI raises ₹40 crore to bring AI hiring to India's frontline workers
item.description: Hunar.AI has raised ₹40 crore in a Series A led by Blume Ventures. PhysicsWallah's Alakh Pandey and Prateek Maheshwari also invested.

item.title: The Pant Project raises ₹109 crore to grow from 25 to 150+ stores
item.description: Menswear brand The Pant Project has raised ₹109 crore in a Series B led by Mirae Asset Venture Investments to expand its stores and range.

item.title: GharForU wants to make finding a room, PG or flat in a new city simpler
item.description: GharForU is a rental search platform for rooms, PGs, hostels and flats, where property owners can also list their property for potential tenants.

item.title: MyHELPR: Gurugram founder Sagar Suhag wants to make home help as easy as ordering food
item.description: Sagar Suhag’s MyHELPR brings cleaning, cooking, laundry, repairs, babysitting, elder care and car wash onto one app, with help arriving in 10–30 minutes depending on availability.

item.title: ProteinX: the smart vending machine that wants to change India’s protein business
item.description: ProteinX’s smart vending machine mixes and serves fresh protein and wellness drinks in seconds, with a no-shop, no-staff model for gyms, offices, universities and hospitals.

item.title: Rojgar Suvidha: an app born from a cyber cafe queue, built to fill sarkari job forms for students
item.description: Rojgar Suvidha puts government job notifications, admit cards and results in one place, and its Apply For Me feature lets students upload documents while the team fills the form.
